prohibited_inference: No pipe-level age, material, roughness, condition or failure hazard inferred from city aggregates
No system-input volume inferred from annual consumption
No causal savings inferred from sensor installation, expenditure or potential minimum-night-flow savings
No service continuity inferred from IVRS bulk storage
No audited trend inferred by directly comparing FY2024/25 unaudited NRW with FY2023/24 audited NRW

matching_contract.pairing: paired scenario blocks with common random numbers for exogenous shocks where meaningful
matching_contract.endogenous_failures: may diverge after common exogenous schedule as a consequence of the policy

statistical_plan.pilot_use: estimate variance, runtime and feasible sample size only
statistical_plan.minimum_detectable_effect: must be frozen after pilot and before confirmatory run
statistical_plan.sample_count: must be justified by power analysis; not specified in v0.1
statistical_plan.multiple_testing: Holm family-wise correction within each pre-declared primary-outcome family
statistical_plan.confirmatory_holdout: must remain unavailable to policy tuning and threshold selection

benchmark_targets.accounting_correctness: all known-truth positive and negative controls recover expected results; no silent invariant violation
benchmark_targets.hydraulic_fidelity: differential comparison only on aligned supported EPANET cases and pinned versions
benchmark_targets.leak_detection: Reconstruct 2026 500-scenario Hanoi baselines separately: uncertainty-aware SVR + rolling RF tree variance (93.60% accuracy, 91.58% sensitivity, 0/120 FPs, ROC AUC 0.975, PR AUC 0.993 reported; independent threshold holdout not established in accessible methods and code not public) and Dynamic Residual Masking (91.60% five-sensor, 93.80% 31-sensor reported; paper-specific). Then evaluate full LeakDB by frozen scenario-held-out and cross-topology lanes. Thresholds fit only on a calibration partition; report exact binomial uncertainty, sensitivity, specificity, precision, F1, MCC, balanced accuracy, PR/ROC AUC, calibration and detection delay.
benchmark_targets.leak_localization: exact pipe/node Top-1 and Top-3, graph/metric distance p50/p90, calibration and abstention
benchmark_targets.sensor_placement: Compare existing/reference, seeded-random, topology-only shortest-path, hydraulic-sensitivity/observability, published topology+sensitivity hybrid, probabilistic Dynamic Residual Masking / game-theoretic pseudo-Jacobian placement, cascading-aware placement, and decision-aware placement at matched sensor count and whole-life cost. Reconstruct exact source task/split before numeric SOTA claims. Include telemetry uptime, false-dispatch load, crew/parts/contractor queues, independently verified repair, service shortfall and worst-group outcome.
benchmark_targets.robustness: report Pareto sets and minimax regret across held-out model families; do not use a single weighted score
benchmark_targets.resilience_performance_curves: Report node/group service trajectories, first fail-safe and safe-fail threshold crossings, time below threshold, service deficit volume, recovery and recurrence. Model piped and qualified fallback service separately with finite water, quality, staff, vehicle, fuel/energy, access and replenishment capacity. Keep available, remaining and realized response capacity distinct. Thresholds must be sourced or stakeholder/rights-declared; otherwise threshold analysis is indeterminate.
benchmark_targets.hierarchical_hydroinformatics: Compare monolithic, per-tier and hierarchical cascade systems across network-level risk/budget prioritization, DMA-level SCADA early warning and in-situ last-mile confirmation. Report per-tier calibration/abstention and end-to-end missed events, false escalation/dispatch, time-to-confirmation, unnecessary field visits/excavation, crew queues, compute/energy/bandwidth, lifecycle cost and verified service outcomes.
benchmark_targets.digital_twin_maturity: Assess M0 conceptual, M1 offline/retrospective, M2 connected pilot, M3 operational decision support and M4 independently audited decision-to-service closure. M4 requires linked observation, state estimate, calibrated uncertainty, recommendation, human authorization, action/work order, independent verification, measured and persistent service outcome, safety gates, rollback and post-event model discrepancy review. M4 does not imply autonomous actuation.
benchmark_targets.leak_validation_integrity: Separate paper-matched 500-scenario Hanoi reproduction, full 1000-scenario Hanoi/1000-scenario Net1 scenario-held-out evaluation, and bidirectional cross-topology transfer. Group split by entire scenario and related seed/config family before windows/features; fit transforms/model/threshold only on train/calibration, evaluate once on sealed test. Publish frozen split membership and SHA-256 digests. Report event, timestep/delay, localization and operational metrics separately. Require source archive/version digest and blind evaluator isolation. Keep BattLeDIM L3 external network/time-period results and Slovak L4 weak-label temporal results as separate non-pooled lanes; neither is a secret blind holdout in its current public form.

provenance_receipt.replay: deterministic replay must bind exact versions and inputs

limitations: The protocol is a design specification, not an executed experiment.
It is not an externally timestamped pre-registration.
No fixed sample count or minimum detectable effect is asserted until pilot variance and a confirmatory power analysis are available.
No synthetic success is evidence of municipal field impact.
Public FY2024/25 annual report source-byte snapshot and page-render verification remain incomplete.

outcome_contract.paired_difference: defined_only_when_both_arms_have_valid_numeric_values_with_exactly_the_same_evidence_status; otherwise delta is indeterminate with explicit missingness or evidence_status_mismatch
outcome_contract.cross_status_comparison: disallowed_by_default; requires a separately named, versioned, preregistered and validated bridge

L0_paper_reproduction.rule: reproduce paper-specific scenarios, sensors, preprocessing, labels and operating threshold where artifacts permit
L0_paper_reproduction.comparison_claim: numeric replication only if exact scenario IDs, sensor assumptions, split and metrics match

L1_full_corpus_scenario_holdout.rule: split on complete scenario identities before any windows, augmentation or feature generation

L2_cross_topology_transfer.rule: train and calibrate on one topology, test on the other, then reverse
L2_cross_topology_transfer.claim_limit: two-topology synthetic transfer only; not multi-utility or field generalization

published_baselines.threshold_calibration_status: independent_sealed_threshold_holdout_not_established_in_accessible_methods; paper describes cutoff selected to ensure zero FPs on the same 120 negatives
published_baselines.comparability_limit: paper-reported result on a 500-scenario subset; not independently reproduced or proven to be an unseen-scenario generalization result
paper-reported sensor-placement/detection result; exact subset identity relative to other 500-case Hanoi studies is not confirmed

published_baselines.threshold_calibration_status: paper-specific; reconstruct calibration and holdout partitions before direct numerical comparison
published_baselines.comparability_limit: integrated multi-network paper baseline; in-house pooled results and public BattLeDIM 2019 external validation must remain distinct; not a matched CivBench leaderboard result

confidence_contract.zero_false_positive_interpretation: zero observed false positives does not imply zero population false-positive rate
